requirements.text: In mobile card view, each card's expand/collapse chevron row appears at the bottom of the card, after all of the card's data rows, instead of before them at the top. The row stays left-aligned within the card as it is today; it does not become a full-width footer bar.
tests: R1: renders the chevron row after every data row, as the last child of the card
R1: a card with a single data row still shows the chevron row below that row
R1: a card with many tall data rows keeps the chevron row after the last row
R1: a row without expandable content shows no chevron row
R1: tapping the chevron opens the detail panel for its own card only
R1: the chevron stays inside the card and its click does not trigger the row click
R1: Enter and Space toggle the chevron and aria-expanded follows the panel

requirements.text: The mobile chevron row's spacing and separator reflect its new position as the last row of the card: the separator that currently sits below the chevron row and the bottom margin that assumed a top row are removed or moved to the top edge of the row.
tests: R2: no bottom border or bottom margin separates the chevron row from the card body
R2: the chevron row is separated from the data above it by a top border and top margin
R2: the chevron row keeps left alignment and its flex layout

requirements.text: Expanding a mobile card still opens its detail panel immediately below that card, with the chevron row directly above the panel.
tests: R3: a collapsed card shows no panel and an expanded card shows its panel below the card
R3: the chevron row sits between the card data and the panel it opens
R3: with two cards expanded each chevron sits above its own panel
R3: collapsing from the panel chrome closes the same panel

requirements.text: Desktop view is unchanged: its expand/collapse chevron remains in the first column of the table row, not at the bottom of a card.
tests: R4: the chevron stays in the first column of the table row and no mobile chevron row renders
R4: resizing mobile to desktop and back switches between bottom-of-card and first-column placement

requirements.text: The documentation that describes the mobile chevron as a top-of-card row is updated to describe it as a bottom-of-card row.
tests: R5: the expand-collapse docs describe the chevron row at the bottom of the card
